prompts.master: Rebuild the playable layout of the Rift Hunters Waterfall Ruins panorama in image1, with image2 (original Plain) as the STRICT fine-detail art reference. Preserve overall LEFT forest ruins / MIDDLE ancient waterfalls / RIGHT violet circular arena order, full-bleed 3:1 panorama, upper-left entry temple and final great violet circle far right. User reports too little maneuvering space and many inaccessible paths. Replace the maze of narrow roads and scattered tree/ruin islands by broad continuous flat earth-and-grass plateaus and HUGE open combat clearings. REMOVE at least half of the decorative clutter from land, especially center road trees/ruins/fences. At least 60 percent of whole image is unobstructed solid walkable ground; waterfalls and forest scenery concentrated along outer margins and localized river channels. Main open western plateau and main open central plateau each provide large space for a party to circle mobs freely, with wide landings and several obvious interconnected wide land routes. CRUCIAL northern alternate route: a clearly continuous very broad flat solid land terrace running from the upper-left entrance eastward across the ENTIRE TOP OF BOTH WESTERN AND CENTRAL REGIONS, roughly y=12%-25%, crossing NO water and NO cliffs, completely inside the frame with room above and below the road. Rivers descend beneath this solid terrace instead of slicing through it. FIRST bridge between left and central regions around x=35%,y=55% remains DESTROYED and IMPASSABLE: two short broken ends attached to their respective banks/supports, wide water gap, NO floating boards/rails/rope fragments. Every point in the western and central land networks can instead use the northern land pass. Second bridge around x=70%,y=55% is INTACT, very wide, correct aligned continuous deck and broad dirt approaches leading into the right violet region. Paths and stairs into the final circle must be very wide, with room to turn outside it. Final circle large, empty flat playable stone, no scattered crystals in its middle. Place forests, rock formations, monuments and ruins mostly on perimeter of open spaces. NO trees, pillars, fences or big rocks in paths or clearings. Keep tiny ground texture decorative and flat. Exact style/finish of original Plain image2: intricate sharp stone masonry, layered finely faceted cliffs, fine leafy foliage in small edge clusters, detailed timber joinery, textured earth/stone paving, sparkling turquoise water, saturated natural colors and purple crystal accents. NOT smooth plastic toy forms, NOT blurry/melted AI upscale, NOT low-resolution coarse pixels, NOT photorealistic. Continuous organic transitions, no straight pasted tile seams. Uniform overhead isometric game camera, same scale throughout, top-left light, no UI/text/characters/borders. Maximum 3:1 wide resolution. Design one coherent large spacious playable landscape rather than a scenic congested montage.

Do NOT add any new trees, rocks, walls, buildings, fences or monuments; do NOT move existing obstacles. Open clearings remain equally generous. Rebuild existing stone with many fine crisp weathered masonry blocks, existing foliage with tiny distinct leaf clusters/branches, timber with fine grain/joinery, water with fine waves and waterfall foam. Preserve the exact silhouette and material/color distribution at all four edges for seamless joining to neighboring regions. No new perspectives or horizon, no crop changes. Match image2's fine graphic fantasy game material finish, rich natural palette and precise dark accents, no smooth plastic/cartoon forms, no photorealism, no blur, no coarse enlarged pixel grid. Output full-bleed square at maximum possible resolution, aiming for at least 2048 square fine details. No text, characters, UI, watermark or borders.

Repaint an irregular natural continuous transition of the soil/grass/paving and seamlessly join any split foliage, masonry, tree, wall or staircase into one coherent object. Keep the exact crop, camera, terrain structure, path widths, all existing broad open playable ground, color palette and crisp fine material details. Keep the outermost left/right edge content and top/bottom edge content exactly aligned to the reference because this patch will be inserted into the unchanged larger map. Do not redesign the scene, do not add obstacles or new buildings, do not narrow any road or plaza. Remove the central rectangle/color/texture discontinuity, cut-off half-objects and misplaced duplicated fragments. Match local terrain colors naturally with no line or gradient blur band. Sharp, richly detailed original fantasy game art, no simplified smooth plastic rendering, no blurry upscaling. Same tall narrow aspect ratio as reference, maximum resolution, full-bleed, no text, border or characters.

The current target has become too simplified and smooth: REMOVE the rounded plastic/cartoon blobs, broad featureless areas, watercolor smudging, soft textures and generic simplified geometry. High definition, extremely fine clean details and sharp edges, polished original game illustration, no coarse pixel-grid enlargement, no blur. previous_prompts: Use case: compositing. Asset: single seamless 3:1 wide horizontal video-game map, opaque full-bleed, sharp detailed pixel art. Edit targets in order: Image1 L1 is left third, Image2 L1p2 is center third, Image3 L1p3 is right third. Stitch these THREE complete maps side by side into ONE continuous horizontal image, retaining the exact original landmark composition and scale: left cyan shrine and waterfall ruins, middle forest ruins and paths, right violet circular rune arena. Repaint narrow joining regions so matching wooden bridges become SINGLE continuous bridges with aligned deck planks/railings and dirt paths join at exactly the same height. No doubled bridge endpoints, no vertical seams, no mismatched shoreline, no discontinuous roads. Preserve all three regions and the violet arena; do not compress or crop a region. Keep each third square-shaped, output total aspect ratio exactly 3:1 and maximum resolution ideally 6000x2000 or higher. High-resolution crisp pixel-art stone, foliage, water and wooden planks; no blurry scaling, no painterly smoothing. Continuous walkable east-west dirt route through left and center maps, crossing well-aligned bridges into the right violet arena. Small stones on dirt paths are sparse decorative pebbles, leaving wide paths. Match original overhead isometric perspective and top-left light. No characters, no text, no labels, no UI, no border, no empty margins.

Edit this SINGLE panorama game map, preserve its 3:1 aspect ratio, original left shrine, middle forest ruins and right violet rune arena. This is a precise continuity and gameplay-readability correction. Repaint BOTH former joins broadly and organically: there must be NO straight vertical boundary anywhere, no sudden change of texture density, no split scenery, no rectangular pasted regions. In the central-right transition, interleave green trees, mossy cliff terraces, waterfalls and gradually increasing small violet crystals across a broad irregular diagonal band; merge river channels and rock formations into a single connected terrain. The bridge decks must be SINGLE continuous bridges connected cleanly to wide dirt landings at exactly the same level, with coherent railings and consistent perspective. Repaint the central left bridge vicinity so one uninterrupted road crosses one bridge, with no stacked/doubled bridges, cutoff rivers, leftover piers, or strange cliff discontinuity. Widen ALL major dirt roads and junctions substantially (at least 120-180 pixels in the nominal 3762-unit map), move obstructing trees/ruined arch pillars to the edges, create generous clear rounded plazas at bends where a player can circle enemies. Remove all stones from the middle of paths; small decorative rocks only alongside path edges. All roads smooth, broad, clear, connected, no bottlenecks except bridge crossings, and bridge decks also wide enough for maneuvering. Keep original landscape landmarks/style/lighting, crisp detailed pixel-art, sharp foliage and stone, no blur, no characters, no UI, no text, no border. Output full-bleed 3:1 panoramic image at maximum resolution. Make this convincingly ONE coherent hand-drawn map, not three pasted illustrations.

Precise edit of this single 3:1 panorama game map. Keep its composition, detailed sharp art, spacious roads, right violet arena and second bridge unchanged. Change ONLY the first wooden bridge, which crosses the left river around x=35% width and y=55% height: it is DESTROYED and clearly IMPASSABLE, with a large missing center deck, broken hanging planks and rails at the two remaining ends, visible water gap between them. No intact planks/rails that could be walked across the gap. The second bridge farther right must remain fully intact and aligned. Add a broad, natural alternate DIRT LAND ROUTE across the upper left/central terrain, above the broken bridge and around the top of the waterfalls: a continuous wide stone-and-earth terrace along the north upper edge connecting the left ruins to the central forest section. Keep this route visually obvious and free of obstacles, cliffs/water on its sides, wide clear landings and bends so the player can turn. This is not another bridge: it is a solid continuous upper plateau/land pass naturally part of the terrain. Keep the original left temple entrance near the upper-left corner with a clear accessible landing for the player start. Preserve lower cyan shrine, vegetation variety, all other landmarks, seamless organic forest-to-violet transition. Do not introduce straight vertical seams or new texture differences. Full-bleed exact 3:1 aspect ratio, maximum resolution, sharp natural detailed stylized game map, no characters, text, UI or borders.
